title: State Count Growth: Ends-With Patterns vs a^n b^n Limit
description: build_ends_with automates the 'ends with pattern' DFA construction: states 0..n represent how much of the pattern is matched. build_anbn_up_to attempts a^n b^n but must cap states at max_n, proving no finite DFA works. Tests show each machine fails on its own witness string.
source: draft: omp free model + edit: codex

steps.description: build_ends_with: for pattern length n, creates states 0..n. For each state i and alphabet char, computes candidate = pattern[:i] + ch, then finds longest k where candidate suffix matches pattern prefix. delta[i][ch] = k. Returns machine with start=0, accept={n}.
The while loop (lines 13-14) is the KMP-style suffix/prefix match: it keeps the longest partial match alive instead of resetting to 0.
run_dfa generic runner: starts at start state, loops over input, checks delta, updates state, returns True if final state in accept.
Test loop: builds machines for patterns 'a', 'ab', 'abc', 'abca', 'abcab' over alphabet 'abc'. Prints state count and which probes accepted. Pattern of length k has k+1 states.

steps.question: Why does 'abcab' pattern with 5 states accept none of the probes?
steps.answer: The probes are 'abc', 'abcab', 'cab', 'ccca', 'abcabc'  -  none of these end with 'abcab'

steps.description: build_anbn_up_to: states are (phase, count) tuples. Phase 'a' counts up on 'a', transitions to 'b' phase on 'b'. Phase 'b' counts down on 'b'. Accept state is ('b', 0). max_n caps the count because DFA must be finite.
in_anbn ground truth checker: string is a^n b^n if length even, n>=1, and string equals 'a'*n + 'b'*n.
Test loop for max_n in [3, 5, 20]: builds machine, creates witness = 'a'^(max_n+1) + 'b'^(max_n+1), runs tests. Marks WRONG when machine verdict differs from ground truth.
Output: 'a'->2 states, 'ab'->3 states, 'abc'->4 states, 'abca'->5 states, 'abcab'->6 states. Accepted probes shown for each.
Each max_n machine fails on its witness (one more pair than it can count). Witness formula: 'a'^(max_n+1) + 'b'^(max_n+1). No finite max_n works.
